body.name: \(\Theta_{xa}\)
body.def: Let \(\Theta^\circ_{xa}\) be the set of \((\alpha,v)\in[1,4]\times[-\log2,0]\) satisfying \(\log\underline S_{xa}(z)-\log(1+Dz^{-\beta})\le v-\alpha\log z\le\log\overline S_{xa}(z)-\log(1-Dz^{-\beta})\) at both \(z=T^{\mathrm{ci}}_{n,m}\) and \(z=eT^{\mathrm{ci}}_{n,m}\), with \(\log0=-\infty\). Set \(\Theta_{xa}=\Theta^\circ_{xa}\) when the raw region is nonempty, and set \(\Theta_{xa}=\{(1,-\log2)\}\) otherwise.
body.role: bias-aware parameter region with zero-width off-coverage totalization
